No AI-looking artifacts

Shallow depth of field

Very important
Treat each uploaded image independently.
Generate one new variation for each reference photo.

The person must remain instantly recognizable in every generated image.

slides.text: The burnout symptom nobody warned me about
Trust me, I know.

The first habit that actually helped was checking in with my emotions every evening. (I use the Kokoro app.)
Slowly, the things you once loved stop feeling exciting.
Burnout whispers long before it screams.

posts.caption: Some things I wish someone had told me sooner 🤍 I use the Kokoro app to help me slow down and check in with myself every day.
